import pytest
from invoicing.service import Invoice, pay_invoice, InvoiceClosedError


def test_paid_invoice_rejects_payment():
    inv = Invoice(id="i1", status="paid", balance_due=0.0)
    with pytest.raises(InvoiceClosedError):
        pay_invoice(inv, 10.0)
    assert inv.balance_due == 0.0
explanation: Constructs a finalized (paid) invoice and asserts pay_invoice rejects the payment with balance unchanged. No existing test pays a finalized invoice, which is why narrowing the guard survived.
rationale: pytest.raises(InvoiceClosedError) on a paid invoice is the assertion that detects the weakened guard.
